The Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 30.11.2023 has passed the following order:-
"1.

In compliance of order dated 18.11.2023, the prosecutrix has appeared along with Lady Constable Ms. Sonika and S.I. Sri Jeevan Sahai of Police Station Tikuniya District Lakhimpur Kheri before this Court.

entities.text: Police Station Tikuniya District Lakhimpur Kheri
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: On asking whether she want to marry with the applicant, she stated that she wants to marry the applicant and live with him.

2. Heard Sri Jitendra Kumar Gupta holding brief of Sri Suresh Kumar Gupta, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri G.D. Bhutt learned AGA-I for the State and perused the record.
3.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant with a prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No.249 of 2022 under sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and 5 j(ii)/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Tikuniya District Lakhimpur Kheri.

entities.text: Police Station Tikuniya District Lakhimpur Kheri
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C. indicates that physical relation was established out of consent and as per medical report she was 15-17 years at the relevant time.
She has become major as per school certificate in the month of September, 2023.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant had given consent to marry with the prosecutrix that is why interim bail was granted to him by this Court vide order dated 16.05.2023.
He has submitted that the marriage could not perform for the reason that the prosecutrix was in Nari Niketan as she was minor but she has become major.
Today, the prosecutrix has stated that she is ready to marry with the applicant.
It is also informed that the prosecutrix had given birth to a male child who is alongwith her.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that interim bail order may again be granted to the applicant for two months to perform the marriage with the prosecutrix.
6. Learned AGA has no objection if the applicant wants to marry with the prosecutrix.

7. Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, after hearing learned counsel for the parties and looking to the fact that prosecutrix and applicant both are ready to marry, in my opinion, the applicant may be granted interim bail for two months.

8. List in the second week of February, 2024.
9.

Learned counsel for the applicant is directed to file proof of marriage on the next date of listing along with an affidavit and shall give an undertaking that he will keep the prosecutrix as his wife along with him.

sentences.text:
Let the applicant, Baljeet Lodhi, be released on interim bail for two months in the above case crime number on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Court concerned with the following conditions :-
(i) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(ii) The applicant shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed, either personally or through his counsel.
In case of his absence, without sufficient cause, the trial court may proceed against him under Section 229-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iii) In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure his presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C. is issued and the applicant fails to appear before the court on the date fixed in such proclamation, then the trial court shall initiate proceedings against him, in accordance with law, under Section 174-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iv) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed for (i) opening of the case, (ii) framing of charge and (iii) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.

If in the opinion of the trial court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the trial court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against him in accordance with law.

11. It is made clear that the observations made in this order are limited to the purpose of determination of this bail application and will in no way be construed as an expression on the merits of the case.
The Trial Court shall be absolutely free to arrive at its independent conclusions on the basis of evidence led unaffected by anything in this order."
Learned counsel for applicant submits that under the interim bail granted to him vide court's order dated 30.11.2023.
Applicant has filed the marriage certificate with the victim.
The applicant is in jail since 27.09.2022.

Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer however, could not dispute the fact that victim is a consenting party and her radio-logical age is 15-17 years however, plus-minus two years of variation is possible on either side in determination of the age as per the ossification test and the applicant being the accused is entitled to the benefit of higher side in view of the judgment of the Supreme Court passed in the case of "Jaya Mala v. Govt. of J & K, (1982) 2 SCC 538".
On due consideration to the submissions advanced, perusal of the record as also the fact that the applicant is languishing in jail since 27.09.2022, victim is a consenting party as also the fact that applicant has married with the victim, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, I find it Baljeet Lodhi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3513181/
3 to be a fit case for enlarging the applicant on bail.
